philosophy: two outside-reviewer rules: a fresh named-counterparty contract 8-K on a quiet clean base (tested once), and V15 without SIC 35/36/38 (forward only)
preRegistered: squad21-core.mjs header (25 Oct 2026, before any run) + data/strategy-library.json SQ21-CONTRACT10D / V15-NO35 / DEC-CONTRACT-10D-WIDE
standard: both halves (signal before / from 2024-01-01): > 0 after 0.8% and 1.2%, better than the average liquid stock over the same sessions, better than the same stock on its other days, better than same-volatility stocks without a fresh 8-K 1.01, > 0 without its 2 best, 20+ trades and 3+ blocks of 21 sessions, block t >= 2.5, return per year of capital above SPY -> TRADABLE SMALL; block t >= 4.07 -> PROVEN. Every gross return capped at +300% (AUD-1).

notTested.name: Contract filing within 10 days, widened by capital-spending headlines and Asian supplier exposure
notTested.why: not tested: needs a history of capital-spending headlines and Asian supplier exposure data; Asian listings are outside the US price data

SQ21-CONTRACT10D.why: lost money after 0.8% costs in the older half; lost money after 1.2% costs in the older half; not better than the average stock in the older half; not better than the same stocks on their other days in the older half; loses without its 2 best in the older half; block t -4.64 under 2.5 in the older half; lost money after 0.8% costs in the newer half; lost money after 1.2% costs in the newer half; not better than the average stock in the newer half; not better than the same stocks on their other days in the newer half; loses without its 2 best in the newer half; block t -4.46 under 2.5 in the newer half; not better than same-volatility stocks without a fresh 8-K 1.01 in the older half (-0.9%, 839 trades with that yardstick); not better than same-volatility stocks without a fresh 8-K 1.01 in the newer half (-1.1%, 1025 trades with that yardstick); return per year of capital tied up -79.3% not above the S&P 500 on the same days in the older half (1.9%); return per year of capital tied up -80.8% not above the S&P 500 on the same days in the newer half (11.3%)
SQ21-CONTRACT10D.name: Fresh 8-K 1.01 contract with a named counterparty, quiet clean base 1-10 sessions later; stop the signal low, exit under the 10-day average

sameVolatility.note: the reviewer's yardstick (an extra gate): same 20-day volatility decile on the signal day, no item-1.01 8-K in sessions t-10..t, the same buy and sell sessions

materiality.note: INFORMATION ONLY, not part of the rule (reviewer's 10%-of-revenue condition): trades whose matched sentence names exactly one dollar amount (100k USD+, no per-share / per-unit price), divided by the latest yearly revenue public on the signal day (SEC frames via quality.mjs, 100 days after the year end).

dealTypes.note: INFORMATION ONLY, not part of the rule (squad21-core dealType: financing / corporate = lender, bank or fund counterparty, or a credit / underwriting / merger / voting / cooperation / purchase agreement in the sentence; else commercial)

SQ21-CONTRACT10D.yardstick: capBoth (AUD-1: trades and every yardstick capped at +300% alike)

V15-NO35.name: V15 F-score uptrend without SIC 35/36/38 (forward paper only, never backtested)
V15-NO35.why: the SIC 35/36/38 exclusion was chosen from V15's own older-half results, so a historical test cannot validate it; judged only on its forward paper record (from 2026-10-27) by the comeback board

latest.label: MONITORING ONLY: a later run on newer data. It is NOT a new verdict and changes nothing; the verdict is firstRun (frozen at the first complete run, never overwritten).
